comment: Arm-specific limits + kinematics for the operator console and the standalone grabber. EDIT THIS (or let calibration flows update it) when porting to another arm - nothing is hardcoded in the code. The planar model (fitted EXACTLY, 0.00 mm residual on 8 live poses, 2026-07-28): P = base + link1*e^i(J2+j2_offset) + link2*e^i(J2+J3+j3_offset). Feasibility = |P-base| <= link1+link2-extension_margin AND predicted J2 >= j2_min+j2_margin. reach_hard_mm/inner_reach_mm are legacy origin-circle guards used only when the kinematic block is absent.
